blocks.text: GARAGE CLEANOUT FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions About Garage Cleanout Services in Pickering

items.q: How much do garage cleanout services cost in Pickering?
a: Pricing is confirmed free at an on-site walkthrough based on how full the garage is — never how long it’s been that way.

items.q: Our garage hasn't parked a car in twenty years — is that unusual?
a: Not at all. It’s one of the most common calls we get in Pickering’s original neighbourhoods, and there’s no judgment attached to the timeline.

items.q: Can you clear a garage ahead of an addition being built?
a: With real care. Pieces that look like they carry genuine value get set aside for a proper look rather than swept into general disposal.

items.q: Do you charge extra for a garage that's completely packed?
a: The price reflects the actual volume and sorting required, not a flat surcharge — a fuller garage costs more because it genuinely takes more time.

items.q: What happens to tools and equipment still in good condition?
a: Donation partners are checked first for anything still usable; only genuinely worn-out items go to disposal.

items.q: Can you clear the garage the same day I call?
a: Often, yes — trucks run seven days a week, 6AM to 11PM.
